sql:
select  
  region_1.r_comment, 
  orders_1.o_totalprice, 
  partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
  partsupp_1.ps_suppkey, 
  min(
    orders_1.o_orderdate), 
  partsupp_1.ps_comment, 
  count(
    partsupp_1.ps_comment)
from 
  region as region_1
      inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
      on (region_1.r_regionkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
    inner join orders as orders_1
    on (region_1.r_regionkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
where orders_1.o_orderdate >= orders_1.o_orderdate
group by orders_1.o_totalprice, partsupp_1.ps_availqty, partsupp_1.ps_comment, partsupp_1.ps_suppkey, region_1.r_comment;
nl: Find the comment for each region, along with the total price of orders placed by customers in those regions, the available quantity and supplier key of parts supplied to those regions, the earliest order date, the comment for each part supply, and the count of comments for each part supply, considering all instances where orders were placed on or after their own order date, grouped by the total price of orders, available quantity of parts, comment for each part supply, supplier key, and region comment.

(select

sql:

    part_1.p_retailprice),

  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    orders_1.o_comment, 
    region_1.r_comment
  from 
    region as region_1
          inner join part as part_1
          on (region_1.r_regionkey = part_1.p_partkey )
        inner join customer as customer_1
        on (part_1.p_partkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
      inner join orders as orders_1
      on (region_1.r_regionkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )

  );

(select

(select  
    region_1.r_regionkey,

sql:

    lineitem_1.l_linenumber,

(select  
    region_1.r_comment,

          inner join nation as nation_1
            inner join lineitem as lineitem_1

          on (lineitem_1.l_partkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
        inner join supplier as supplier_1
        on (partsupp_1.ps_suppkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
      inner join region as region_1
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = region_1.r_regionkey )

nl: Combine the results of finding line items from orders placed by customers located in nations with a region key less than their nation key, along with the corresponding part supplier information and regional comments, and finding line items from orders placed by customers located in any region, including those with a non-null region key, along with the corresponding part supplier information and regional comments.

sql:

sql:
select  
  lineitem_1.l_orderkey,

  lineitem_1.l_partkey,

sql:
(select  
    orders_2.o_custkey
  from 
    partsupp as partsupp_1
          inner join partsupp as partsupp_2
          on (partsupp_1.ps_partkey = partsupp_2.ps_partkey )
        inner join nation as nation_1
        on (partsupp_2.ps_partkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
      inner join orders as orders_1
        inner join orders as orders_2
        on (orders_1.o_orderkey = orders_2.o_orderkey )
      on (nation_1.n_nationkey = orders_2.o_orderkey )
  where orders_2.o_orderdate >= orders_1.o_orderdate
  )
UNION
(select  
    orders_2.o_custkey
  from 
    partsupp as partsupp_1
          inner join partsupp as partsupp_2
          on (partsupp_1.ps_partkey = partsupp_2.ps_partkey )
        inner join nation as nation_1
        on (partsupp_2.ps_partkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
      inner join orders as orders_1
        inner join orders as orders_2
        on (orders_1.o_orderkey = orders_2.o_orderkey )
      on (nation_1.n_nationkey = orders_2.o_orderkey )
  where partsupp_2.ps_availqty = orders_2.o_orderkey
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding customers who placed orders with later dates than their own previous orders from the same nation, and those whose order quantities match the available stock of a part supplied by a company in the same nation.

    lineitem_1.l_commitdate)

where lineitem_1.l_receiptdate <= lineitem_1.l_commitdate

  region_1.r_regionkey, 
  min(
    customer_2.c_custkey), 
  max(
    customer_2.c_acctbal), 
  avg(

  customer_1.c_acctbal, 
  customer_1.c_mktsegment, 
  customer_2.c_acctbal, 
  supplier_1.s_address, 
  customer_1.c_nationkey, 
  customer_1.c_address, 
  count(
    customer_2.c_comment)
from 
  orders as orders_1
      inner join region as region_1
      on (orders_1.o_orderkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
    inner join supplier as supplier_1
        inner join customer as customer_1
        on (supplier_1.s_suppkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
      inner join customer as customer_2
      on (customer_1.c_custkey = customer_2.c_custkey )
    on (region_1.r_regionkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
where supplier_1.s_nationkey is not NULL
group by customer_1.c_acctbal, customer_1.c_address, customer_1.c_mktsegment, customer_1.c_nationkey, customer_2.c_acctbal, region_1.r_regionkey, supplier_1.s_address;

  partsupp_2.ps_supplycost, 
  sum(
    partsupp_2.ps_supplycost), 
  partsupp_2.ps_comment, 
  max(
    partsupp_2.ps_partkey), 
  partsupp_1.ps_partkey
from 
  partsupp as partsupp_1
    inner join partsupp as partsupp_2
    on (partsupp_1.ps_partkey = partsupp_2.ps_partkey )
where partsupp_2.ps_supplycost = partsupp_1.ps_supplycost
group by partsupp_1.ps_partkey, partsupp_2.ps_comment, partsupp_2.ps_supplycost;
nl: Find the supply cost, total supply cost, and comment for each part, along with the maximum part key, for parts that have the same supply cost from different suppliers, grouping the results by part key, comment, and supply cost.

sql:
(select  
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    orders_1.o_shippriority, 
    orders_1.o_clerk, 
    orders_1.o_orderkey, 
    orders_1.o_orderstatus
  from 
    orders as orders_1
  where orders_1.o_orderkey is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    orders_1.o_shippriority, 
    orders_1.o_clerk, 
    orders_1.o_orderkey, 
    orders_1.o_orderstatus
  from 
    orders as orders_1
  where orders_1.o_comment is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding orders placed by customers that have an order key and orders placed by customers that have a comment.

sql:
(select  
    supplier_1.s_phone, 
    supplier_1.s_acctbal, 
    region_1.r_regionkey, 
    region_1.r_name, 
    supplier_1.s_address, 
    supplier_1.s_comment, 
    region_1.r_comment
  from 
    region as region_1
      inner join supplier as supplier_1
      on (region_1.r_regionkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
  where supplier_1.s_acctbal is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select distinct 
    supplier_1.s_phone, 
    supplier_1.s_acctbal, 
    region_1.r_regionkey, 
    region_1.r_name, 
    supplier_1.s_address, 
    supplier_1.s_comment, 
    region_1.r_comment
  from 
    region as region_1
      inner join supplier as supplier_1
      on (region_1.r_regionkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
  where region_1.r_comment is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding suppliers with non-null account balances, including their phone numbers, account balances, regions, regional names, addresses, comments, and regional comments, who are located in regions, and finding distinct instances of suppliers with non-null regional comments, including their phone numbers, account balances, regions, regional names, addresses, comments, and regional comments, who are also located in regions.

sql:
(select  
    part_1.p_size, 
    part_1.p_container, 
    part_1.p_retailprice, 
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
          inner join part as part_1
          on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = part_1.p_partkey )
        inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
        on (lineitem_1.l_suppkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
      inner join region as region_1
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
  where part_1.p_container is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    part_1.p_size, 
    part_1.p_container, 
    part_1.p_retailprice, 
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
          inner join part as part_1
          on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = part_1.p_partkey )
        inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
        on (lineitem_1.l_suppkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
      inner join region as region_1
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
  where partsupp_1.ps_partkey is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding the size, container, retail price of parts, and supply cost from parts supplied to orders placed by customers located in regions where the part container is not empty, with finding the same information for parts supplied to orders where the part key in the supplier's catalog is not empty.

sql:
(select  
    customer_1.c_name
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
        inner join supplier as supplier_1
          inner join customer as customer_1
            inner join part as part_1
            on (customer_1.c_custkey = part_1.p_partkey )
          on (supplier_1.s_suppkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
        on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
      inner join supplier as supplier_2
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = supplier_2.s_suppkey )
  where lineitem_1.l_suppkey is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    customer_1.c_name
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
        inner join supplier as supplier_1
          inner join customer as customer_1
            inner join part as part_1
            on (customer_1.c_custkey = part_1.p_partkey )
          on (supplier_1.s_suppkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
        on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
      inner join supplier as supplier_2
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = supplier_2.s_suppkey )
  where supplier_2.s_phone < supplier_1.s_name
  );
nl: Find customer names from orders placed by customers who received items supplied by suppliers, excluding those cases where the phone number of one supplier is less than the name of another supplier involved in the same order.

sql:
(select  
    customer_1.c_nationkey, 
    customer_1.c_phone
  from 
    customer as customer_1
  where customer_1.c_phone > customer_1.c_mktsegment
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    customer_1.c_nationkey, 
    customer_1.c_phone
  from 
    customer as customer_1
  where customer_1.c_phone is not NULL
  );
nl: Find customers with a nation key and phone number, excluding those whose phone number is not empty, for the group of customers where their phone number is greater than their market segment.

sql:
(select  
    supplier_1.s_nationkey, 
    supplier_1.s_acctbal
  from 
    supplier as supplier_1
  where supplier_1.s_suppkey is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    supplier_1.s_nationkey, 
    supplier_1.s_acctbal
  from 
    supplier as supplier_1
  where supplier_1.s_name is not NULL
  );
nl: Find suppliers with a nation key and account balance, excluding those that also have a name.

sql:
(select  
    partsupp_1.ps_partkey, 
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, 
    partsupp_1.ps_comment, 
    partsupp_1.ps_availqty
  from 
    partsupp as partsupp_1
  where partsupp_1.ps_partkey is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    partsupp_1.ps_partkey, 
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, 
    partsupp_1.ps_comment, 
    partsupp_1.ps_availqty
  from 
    partsupp as partsupp_1
  where partsupp_1.ps_partkey is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all available parts with their supply costs and comments, and finding all available parts with their supply costs and comments.

sql:
(select  
    part_1.p_container, 
    nation_1.n_nationkey, 
    partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
    part_1.p_mfgr, 
    nation_1.n_regionkey, 
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, 
    part_1.p_brand
  from 
    nation as nation_1
      inner join part as part_1
        inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
        on (partsupp_1.ps_partkey = part_1.p_partkey )
      on (nation_1.n_nationkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
  where part_1.p_retailprice is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    part_1.p_container, 
    nation_1.n_nationkey, 
    partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
    part_1.p_mfgr, 
    nation_1.n_regionkey, 
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, 
    part_1.p_brand
  from 
    nation as nation_1
      inner join part as part_1
        inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
        on (partsupp_1.ps_partkey = part_1.p_partkey )
      on (nation_1.n_nationkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
  where nation_1.n_regionkey is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding the container type, nation key, available quantity, manufacturer, region key, supply cost, and brand for parts supplied by nations where the retail price is known and finding the same information for parts supplied by nations in a specific region.

sql:
select  
  count(*), 
  region_1.r_regionkey, 
  region_1.r_comment
from 
  region as region_1
where region_1.r_comment is not NULL
group by region_1.r_comment, region_1.r_regionkey;
nl: How many regions are there for each unique comment and region key, considering only regions with a non-empty comment?

sql:
(select  
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, 
    partsupp_1.ps_partkey, 
    partsupp_1.ps_suppkey
  from 
    partsupp as partsupp_1
  where partsupp_1.ps_supplycost >= partsupp_1.ps_supplycost
  )
UNION
(select  
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, 
    partsupp_1.ps_partkey, 
    partsupp_1.ps_suppkey
  from 
    partsupp as partsupp_1
  where partsupp_1.ps_availqty is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all instances of supply costs, part keys, and supplier keys for supplies with a cost greater than or equal to their own cost, and finding all instances of supply costs, part keys, and supplier keys where the available quantity is not unknown.

sql:
(select  
    partsupp_1.ps_comment, 
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, 
    partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
    partsupp_1.ps_partkey
  from 
    partsupp as partsupp_1
  where partsupp_1.ps_supplycost < partsupp_1.ps_supplycost
  )
UNION
(select  
    partsupp_1.ps_comment, 
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, 
    partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
    partsupp_1.ps_partkey
  from 
    partsupp as partsupp_1
  where partsupp_1.ps_partkey is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all instances of part supply comments, costs, availability quantities, and part keys for supplies with a cost less than themselves, which will result in no instances, and part supply comments, costs, availability quantities, and part keys where the part key exists.

sql:
(select  
    orders_1.o_shippriority, 
    partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
    customer_1.c_phone, 
    partsupp_1.ps_comment, 
    supplier_2.s_nationkey, 
    customer_1.c_address
  from 
    orders as orders_1
        inner join customer as customer_1
        on (orders_1.o_custkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
      inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
          inner join supplier as supplier_1
          on (partsupp_1.ps_suppkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
        inner join supplier as supplier_2
        on (partsupp_1.ps_suppkey = supplier_2.s_suppkey )
      on (orders_1.o_orderkey = supplier_2.s_suppkey )
  where supplier_2.s_nationkey is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    orders_1.o_shippriority, 
    partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
    customer_1.c_phone, 
    partsupp_1.ps_comment, 
    supplier_2.s_nationkey, 
    customer_1.c_address
  from 
    orders as orders_1
        inner join customer as customer_1
        on (orders_1.o_custkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
      inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
          inner join supplier as supplier_1
          on (partsupp_1.ps_suppkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
        inner join supplier as supplier_2
        on (partsupp_1.ps_suppkey = supplier_2.s_suppkey )
      on (orders_1.o_orderkey = supplier_2.s_suppkey )
  where supplier_1.s_nationkey is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding orders placed by customers, including shipping priority and customer phone number, along with available quantity from parts suppliers, comments about these supplies, nation key of the supplier, and customer address for instances where the supplier's nation key is not unknown, and also find similar information but for cases where another related supplier's nation key is not unknown.

sql:
(select  
    supplier_1.s_phone, 
    supplier_1.s_suppkey, 
    supplier_1.s_acctbal, 
    supplier_1.s_comment
  from 
    supplier as supplier_1
  where supplier_1.s_nationkey is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    supplier_1.s_phone, 
    supplier_1.s_suppkey, 
    supplier_1.s_acctbal, 
    supplier_1.s_comment
  from 
    supplier as supplier_1
  where supplier_1.s_phone <= supplier_1.s_name
  );
nl: Find suppliers with a nation key, excluding those whose phone number is less than or equal to their name.

sql:
select  
  nation_1.n_name
from 
  nation as nation_1
where nation_1.n_name is not NULL;
nl: Find all nations with a name.

sql:
(select  
    orders_1.o_comment, 
    orders_1.o_totalprice
  from 
    orders as orders_1
  where orders_1.o_orderpriority is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    orders_1.o_comment, 
    orders_1.o_totalprice
  from 
    orders as orders_1
  where orders_1.o_totalprice is not NULL
  );
nl: Find orders with comments and total prices, excluding those that are also orders with known total prices.

sql:
(select  
    supplier_1.s_name, 
    supplier_1.s_nationkey, 
    supplier_1.s_acctbal, 
    supplier_1.s_phone
  from 
    supplier as supplier_1
  where supplier_1.s_acctbal is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    supplier_1.s_name, 
    supplier_1.s_nationkey, 
    supplier_1.s_acctbal, 
    supplier_1.s_phone
  from 
    supplier as supplier_1
  where supplier_1.s_phone is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding suppliers with a non-null account balance and those with a non-null phone number.

sql:
(select  
    region_1.r_name, 
    region_1.r_regionkey, 
    region_1.r_comment
  from 
    region as region_1
  where region_1.r_regionkey is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    region_1.r_name, 
    region_1.r_regionkey, 
    region_1.r_comment
  from 
    region as region_1
  where region_1.r_name is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all regions with a valid key and finding all regions with a valid name.

sql:
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_quantity, 
    lineitem_1.l_comment
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
  where lineitem_1.l_shipmode >= lineitem_1.l_shipinstruct
  )
UNION
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_quantity, 
    lineitem_1.l_comment
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
  where lineitem_1.l_quantity < lineitem_1.l_extendedprice
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding instances where the shipping mode is greater than or equal to the shipping instructions and the quantity is less than the extended price, including the quantity and any comments for these instances.

sql:
(select  
    nation_1.n_name
  from 
    nation as nation_1
  where nation_1.n_regionkey >= nation_1.n_nationkey
  )
UNION
(select  
    nation_1.n_name
  from 
    nation as nation_1
  where nation_1.n_name >= nation_1.n_name
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding nations where the region key is greater than or equal to the nation key and finding nations where the name is greater than or equal to itself.

sql:
(select  
    region_1.r_regionkey, 
    region_1.r_comment, 
    region_1.r_name
  from 
    region as region_1
  where region_1.r_comment is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    region_1.r_regionkey, 
    region_1.r_comment, 
    region_1.r_name
  from 
    region as region_1
  where region_1.r_name is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding regions with comments and finding regions with names.

sql:
(select  
    partsupp_1.ps_comment, 
    partsupp_1.ps_suppkey
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
      inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
      on (lineitem_1.l_suppkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
  where partsupp_1.ps_comment is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    partsupp_1.ps_comment, 
    partsupp_1.ps_suppkey
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
      inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
      on (lineitem_1.l_suppkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
  where lineitem_1.l_discount is not NULL
  );
nl: Find all instances of supplier comments and keys from supplies used in orders, excluding those that are also associated with order lines having a discount.

sql:
select  
  region_1.r_regionkey, 
  region_1.r_name, 
  region_1.r_comment, 
  max(
    region_1.r_regionkey)
from 
  region as region_1
where region_1.r_name is not NULL
group by region_1.r_comment, region_1.r_name, region_1.r_regionkey;
nl: Find the maximum region key for each group of regions with the same comment and name, considering only regions with a valid name.

sql:
select  
  partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, 
  partsupp_1.ps_partkey, 
  partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
  avg(
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost), 
  partsupp_1.ps_comment, 
  partsupp_1.ps_suppkey, 
  min(
    partsupp_1.ps_partkey)
from 
  partsupp as partsupp_1
where partsupp_1.ps_partkey = partsupp_1.ps_availqty
group by partsupp_1.ps_availqty, partsupp_1.ps_comment, partsupp_1.ps_partkey, partsupp_1.ps_suppkey, partsupp_1.ps_supplycost;
nl: What is the average and minimum supply cost for each available quantity of parts, along with their part key, supplier key, comment, and supply cost, where the part key matches the available quantity?

sql:
(select  
    orders_1.o_orderdate, 
    orders_1.o_orderstatus, 
    orders_1.o_comment, 
    orders_1.o_orderpriority, 
    orders_1.o_clerk
  from 
    orders as orders_1
  where orders_1.o_orderdate < orders_1.o_orderdate
  )
UNION
(select  
    orders_1.o_orderdate, 
    orders_1.o_orderstatus, 
    orders_1.o_comment, 
    orders_1.o_orderpriority, 
    orders_1.o_clerk
  from 
    orders as orders_1
  where orders_1.o_orderpriority is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all instances of orders with no order date and orders that have a specified priority.

sql:
select  
  part_1.p_comment, 
  part_1.p_brand, 
  avg(
    part_1.p_partkey), 
  part_1.p_mfgr, 
  part_1.p_retailprice
from 
  part as part_1
where part_1.p_partkey > part_1.p_size
group by part_1.p_brand, part_1.p_comment, part_1.p_mfgr, part_1.p_retailprice;
nl: What is the average part key for each brand of parts with comments and manufacturers, considering only parts where the part key is greater than the part size, grouped by brand, comment, manufacturer, and retail price?

sql:
select  
  lineitem_1.l_returnflag, 
  lineitem_1.l_quantity
from 
  lineitem as lineitem_1
where lineitem_1.l_tax is not NULL;
nl: Find all instances where the tax is provided, and for those cases, determine the return flag and quantity of items.

sql:
(select  
    nation_1.n_name, 
    customer_1.c_phone
  from 
    part as part_1
        inner join region as region_1
        on (part_1.p_partkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
      inner join region as region_2
          inner join nation as nation_1
          on (nation_1.n_regionkey = region_2.r_regionkey )
        inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
          inner join customer as customer_1
          on (partsupp_1.ps_partkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
        on (region_2.r_regionkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
      on (region_1.r_regionkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
  where part_1.p_name is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    nation_1.n_name, 
    customer_1.c_phone
  from 
    part as part_1
        inner join region as region_1
        on (part_1.p_partkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
      inner join region as region_2
          inner join nation as nation_1
          on (nation_1.n_regionkey = region_2.r_regionkey )
        inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
          inner join customer as customer_1
          on (partsupp_1.ps_partkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
        on (region_2.r_regionkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
      on (region_1.r_regionkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
  where nation_1.n_name is not NULL
  );
nl: Find the names of nations and phone numbers of customers who have placed orders for parts with non-null names, excluding those instances where the nation name itself is not null.

sql:
(select  
    part_1.p_partkey, 
    part_1.p_size, 
    part_1.p_comment, 
    part_1.p_brand, 
    part_1.p_name, 
    part_1.p_container
  from 
    part as part_1
  where part_1.p_type is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    part_1.p_partkey, 
    part_1.p_size, 
    part_1.p_comment, 
    part_1.p_brand, 
    part_1.p_name, 
    part_1.p_container
  from 
    part as part_1
  where part_1.p_comment is not NULL
  );
nl: Find parts with a type, excluding those that also have a comment.

sql:
select  
  partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, 
  sum(
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost), 
  partsupp_1.ps_suppkey, 
  min(
    region_1.r_regionkey)
from 
  partsupp as partsupp_1
    inner join region as region_1
    on (partsupp_1.ps_partkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
where partsupp_1.ps_comment is not NULL
group by partsupp_1.ps_suppkey, partsupp_1.ps_supplycost;
nl: Find the supply cost and total supply cost for each supplier, along with their supplier key, and the lowest region key, considering only suppliers with comments, grouped by supplier key and supply cost.

sql:
(select  
    nation_1.n_comment
  from 
    nation as nation_1
      inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
      on (nation_1.n_nationkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
  where partsupp_1.ps_supplycost > partsupp_1.ps_supplycost
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    nation_1.n_comment
  from 
    nation as nation_1
      inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
      on (nation_1.n_nationkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
  where partsupp_1.ps_partkey is not NULL
  );
nl: Find nation comments, excluding those from nations with parts suppliers that have a non-null part key, for nations whose parts suppliers do not have a supply cost greater than themselves.

sql:
(select  
    part_1.p_comment
  from 
    part as part_1
  where part_1.p_mfgr is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    part_1.p_comment
  from 
    part as part_1
  where part_1.p_size is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding parts with a known manufacturer and finding parts with a specified size to get all instances of both parts with manufacturing information and parts with size details.

sql:
select  
  part_1.p_brand, 
  part_2.p_partkey, 
  part_2.p_brand, 
  part_2.p_container, 
  part_2.p_size, 
  part_1.p_comment, 
  max(
    part_1.p_partkey)
from 
  part as part_1
    inner join part as part_2
    on (part_1.p_partkey = part_2.p_partkey )
where part_2.p_container < part_1.p_container
group by part_1.p_brand, part_1.p_comment, part_2.p_brand, part_2.p_container, part_2.p_partkey, part_2.p_size;
nl: Find the maximum part key for each group of parts with the same brand and comment, where one part has a smaller container than another part with the same characteristics, grouping the results by the brands, comments, container sizes, and part keys of these parts.

sql:
(select  
    partsupp_2.ps_supplycost, 
    partsupp_1.ps_partkey, 
    nation_1.n_nationkey, 
    nation_1.n_name, 
    partsupp_1.ps_comment
  from 
    supplier as supplier_1
      inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
            inner join nation as nation_1
            on (partsupp_1.ps_partkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
          inner join partsupp as partsupp_2
          on (nation_1.n_nationkey = partsupp_2.ps_partkey )
        inner join partsupp as partsupp_3
        on (partsupp_2.ps_partkey = partsupp_3.ps_partkey )
      on (partsupp_3.ps_suppkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
  where partsupp_3.ps_availqty is not NULL
  )

from 
  orders as orders_1
    inner join customer as customer_1
    on (orders_1.o_custkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
where orders_1.o_orderdate is not NULL
group by customer_1.c_address;
nl: Find the minimum customer key and their corresponding address for each customer address, considering only orders with a valid order date, placed by customers.

sql:
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_quantity, 
    nation_1.n_regionkey, 
    lineitem_1.l_shipmode, 
    nation_1.n_nationkey, 
    customer_1.c_mktsegment, 
    lineitem_1.l_partkey, 
    nation_1.n_comment, 
    nation_1.n_name
  from 
    nation as nation_1
        inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
        on (nation_1.n_nationkey = lineitem_1.l_orderkey )
      inner join customer as customer_1
      on (customer_1.c_nationkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
  where lineitem_1.l_shipmode is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_quantity, 
    nation_1.n_regionkey, 
    lineitem_1.l_shipmode, 
    nation_1.n_nationkey, 
    customer_1.c_mktsegment, 
    lineitem_1.l_partkey, 
    nation_1.n_comment, 
    nation_1.n_name
  from 
    nation as nation_1
        inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
        on (nation_1.n_nationkey = lineitem_1.l_orderkey )
      inner join customer as customer_1
      on (customer_1.c_nationkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
  where lineitem_1.l_receiptdate > lineitem_1.l_commitdate
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding orders placed by customers from nations, including details such as quantity ordered, shipping mode, and market segment, for instances where the shipping mode is specified, and for instances where the receipt date exceeds the commit date.

sql:
(select  
    supplier_1.s_phone, 
    supplier_1.s_suppkey
  from 
    supplier as supplier_1
  where supplier_1.s_comment is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    supplier_1.s_phone, 
    supplier_1.s_suppkey
  from 
    supplier as supplier_1
  where supplier_1.s_acctbal > supplier_1.s_acctbal
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding suppliers with a comment and those with an account balance greater than their own account balance, giving their phone number and supplier key.

sql:
select  
  supplier_1.s_nationkey, 
  orders_1.o_custkey, 
  supplier_1.s_address, 
  supplier_1.s_suppkey, 
  sum(
    orders_1.o_shippriority), 
  avg(
    orders_1.o_totalprice), 
  supplier_1.s_comment, 
  max(
    orders_1.o_orderdate)
from 
  customer as customer_1
      inner join orders as orders_1
      on (orders_1.o_custkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
    inner join supplier as supplier_1
    on (customer_1.c_custkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
where customer_1.c_address is not NULL
group by orders_1.o_custkey, supplier_1.s_address, supplier_1.s_comment, supplier_1.s_nationkey, supplier_1.s_suppkey;
nl: What are the nation keys of suppliers, customer keys from orders placed by customers, addresses of suppliers, supplier keys, total shipping priority, average total prices, comments about suppliers, and latest order dates for each group of customer orders and supplier information, considering only customers with valid addresses?

sql:
(select  
    region_3.r_regionkey, 
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    region_3.r_comment, 
    orders_1.o_shippriority, 
    region_1.r_regionkey
  from 
    region as region_1
        inner join region as region_2
          inner join orders as orders_1
          on (region_2.r_regionkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
        on (region_1.r_regionkey = region_2.r_regionkey )
      inner join region as region_3
      on (orders_1.o_orderkey = region_3.r_regionkey )
  where region_2.r_comment is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    region_3.r_regionkey, 
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    region_3.r_comment, 
    orders_1.o_shippriority, 
    region_1.r_regionkey
  from 
    region as region_1
        inner join region as region_2
          inner join orders as orders_1
          on (region_2.r_regionkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
        on (region_1.r_regionkey = region_2.r_regionkey )
      inner join region as region_3
      on (orders_1.o_orderkey = region_3.r_regionkey )
  where region_2.r_regionkey is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding orders placed by customers located in regions with comments and those placed by customers located in regions with known region keys, including the region key, customer identifier, regional comment, shipping priority, and another region key for each order.

sql:
select  
  lineitem_1.l_shipdate, 
  lineitem_1.l_quantity
from 
  lineitem as lineitem_1
where lineitem_1.l_shipdate <= lineitem_1.l_receiptdate;
nl: Find the shipping date and quantity of all orders where the shipment was received on or after the ship date.

sql:
select  
  customer_1.c_comment, 
  min(
    customer_1.c_nationkey)
from 
  customer as customer_1
where customer_1.c_nationkey is not NULL
group by customer_1.c_comment;
nl: What is the minimum nation key for each unique comment made by customers with a known nation of origin?

sql:
select  
  count(*), 
  min(
    nation_1.n_regionkey), 
  nation_2.n_regionkey, 
  nation_1.n_comment
from 
  nation as nation_1
    inner join nation as nation_2
    on (nation_1.n_nationkey = nation_2.n_nationkey )
where nation_1.n_name = nation_2.n_name
group by nation_1.n_comment, nation_2.n_regionkey;
nl: What is the count of matching nations and the minimum region key for each group of nations with the same comment and region key, where two instances of a nation are considered a match if they have the same name?

sql:
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_quantity, 
    lineitem_1.l_returnflag, 
    lineitem_1.l_orderkey, 
    lineitem_1.l_tax, 
    lineitem_1.l_commitdate
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
  where lineitem_1.l_linenumber is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_quantity, 
    lineitem_1.l_returnflag, 
    lineitem_1.l_orderkey, 
    lineitem_1.l_tax, 
    lineitem_1.l_commitdate
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
  where lineitem_1.l_receiptdate is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all instances where order items have a specified line number and finding all instances where order items have a recorded receipt date, considering their quantity, return status, order identifier, tax amount, and commitment date.

sql:
(select  
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    supplier_1.s_address, 
    lineitem_1.l_orderkey, 
    orders_1.o_orderpriority, 
    lineitem_1.l_discount, 
    lineitem_1.l_shipdate
  from 
    orders as orders_1
      inner join nation as nation_1
          inner join customer as customer_1
            inner join supplier as supplier_1
            on (customer_1.c_custkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
          on (supplier_1.s_nationkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
        inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
        on (customer_1.c_custkey = lineitem_1.l_orderkey )
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
  where nation_1.n_name is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    supplier_1.s_address, 
    lineitem_1.l_orderkey, 
    orders_1.o_orderpriority, 
    lineitem_1.l_discount, 
    lineitem_1.l_shipdate
  from 
    orders as orders_1
      inner join nation as nation_1
          inner join customer as customer_1
            inner join supplier as supplier_1
            on (customer_1.c_custkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
          on (supplier_1.s_nationkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
        inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
        on (customer_1.c_custkey = lineitem_1.l_orderkey )
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
  where customer_1.c_acctbal <= supplier_1.s_acctbal
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding orders placed by customers from nations with a name, along with their corresponding suppliers and line items, and finding orders placed by customers whose account balance is less than or equal to that of their corresponding supplier, including details such as customer key, supplier address, order key, order priority, discount, and ship date.

sql:
select  
  customer_1.c_mktsegment, 
  min(
    customer_1.c_custkey), 
  customer_1.c_phone, 
  region_1.r_regionkey, 
  partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
  lineitem_1.l_orderkey
from 
  region as region_1
      inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
      on (region_1.r_regionkey = lineitem_1.l_orderkey )
    inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
      inner join customer as customer_1
      on (partsupp_1.ps_partkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
    on (lineitem_1.l_suppkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
where partsupp_1.ps_suppkey is not NULL
group by customer_1.c_mktsegment, customer_1.c_phone, lineitem_1.l_orderkey, partsupp_1.ps_availqty, region_1.r_regionkey;
nl: What are the market segments of customers, along with their minimum customer key, phone number, region, available quantity from suppliers, and order keys for orders placed by customers, grouped by these characteristics, considering only instances where supplier keys exist?

sql:
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_orderkey, 
    lineitem_1.l_commitdate, 
    lineitem_1.l_linenumber
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
  where lineitem_1.l_quantity is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_orderkey, 
    lineitem_1.l_commitdate, 
    lineitem_1.l_linenumber
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
  where lineitem_1.l_commitdate is not NULL
  );
nl: Find all instances of order keys, commit dates, and line numbers for orders with a specified quantity, excluding those that also have a specified commit date.
